name: display-menu
title: Display Menu
description: The toolbar's Display tool: Layout and Sort once folded in, row height, group by, a Columns drill-in, the Show switches (archived, closed, subtasks) and Reset — one surface, no fills.

meta.whenToUse: How a list's rows look and which lifecycle states it includes, from a ListToolbar.
meta.whenNotToUse: Actions on the view (ListToolbarMenu), or filters on rows (FilterRow).
